name: HJ2-110F101D24-BK-EC
summary: HJ2-110F101D24-BK-EC is a 110 mm harmonic integrated actuator from Leadshine, equipped with a brake and EtherCAT communication. The unit combines a motor, harmonic gearing, drive and encoder for robotic joint integration. The exact-model specification lists 194 N·m peak torque, 84 N·m rated torque under its stated 2000 rpm condition, a 24-bit encoder and a mass of 2600 g. Input-speed and output-speed figures must be distinguished when evaluating this geared actuator.
